profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ESPN+
profile.summary: Innovative professional with 7 years of experience in software development, with 5 years specifically in Android development, as well as variety of web development experience in widely diverse areas such as gaming, social networking, and ecommerce. Inspires, entertains, and educates users via development of state-of-the-art apps. Contributes to all phases of software development lifecycle spanning from conceptualizing and/or transforming concepts into cutting-edge realities to testing, debugging, deployment, and updates. Climbs steep learning curves in minimal time in order to provide users with technology on leading-edge of industry.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Architect/Design and develop Android application for correctional services in multiple states with special requirements like high security, limitation in network access, hardware, software and customized devices.
In charge of leading/architecting and developing of JPay Android consumer app. I built my own MVC-VM architect for the app and have applied lot of new technology for DevOps and Analytic like Fabric Answer/Crashlytic, Jenkins Fabric beta + Fastlane for CI and CD. 
I have built and maintained applications for prisoners in JPay’s customized Android tablets and Desktop to send/read email, video, pictures. Those applications can run in environment with/without network and ability to work perfectly with limited connectivity and complex synchronize system.
Applied Kotlin and moderm Android development like RxJava, Dependency Injection (Dagger2), MVVM-Live data, Android Jetpack.
My works includes the whole cycle of JPay system: Client (Android/Desktop/Customized Tablets apps/ASP.NET websites) -> Web services API (SOAP/RestFul WCF/WA .NET) -> MS Sql Database (Entity Framework, Store procedure, TSQL script). 
I built a CI/CD system to automate Android build and distribute it to QA in multiple testing environment (Development, Pre-productions…) with automation test by Espresso/Katalon. 
Collaborate with product owners and designer to finalize business requirements based on technology possibility of the company. 
Supervise Android development of offshore team members.

positions.description: Program Android application, Webservice, Desktop Application

positions.title: Android Programmer
positions.description:
Designed and developed variety of Android applications for social networking, ecommerce, and educational purposes.

I got experiences in the position about : 
- Android development.
- XMPP chatting protocol (built a small module for easier using XMPP Android Framework)
- Network communication with Server service.
- XML, JSON parsing in network data processing.
- SQLite, Eclipse, Photoshop.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performed as independent and team developer on 3 games and maintenance official website of the company.

-	Developed Kibow official website with team. 
-	Developed 2 Android games (AndEngine) and 1 IOS game (Cocos2D) based on 2 gamble flash games of the company. 
-	Developed some gamble system: baseball gambling, sumo gambling with team.
-	Created mobile portal for the existed gamble system.
-	Used UML to design the mobile portal and gamble system with team.

I got experiences about : 
- Analyze and Design system by UML.
- Android (AndEngine), iOS (Cocos2D) game development.
- PHP framework : Zend, CakePHP, Yii
- JSON parsing and Network communication in Android Java, Objective-C IOS

positions.title: Game developer
positions.description: J2ME game developer, Open GL C++ game engine developer

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I was the first employee of the company and I built the web development core with my boss. 
-	Implemented web development core for the company with team.
-	Implemented and maintained more than 10 website based on the core with Photoshop.
-	Implemented Voucher system for Deal Website.

I got experiences about : 
- PHP development. 
- HTML/CSS + Javascript development.
- MySQL.
- Photoshop.

projects.title: Creative Watchface
projects.description: ** Beautiful watchface for Android smart watch with fully customizable.

projects.title: Generic Billing System for Telephone Company
projects.description:
A generic billing system for telephone communication company to manage customers, import CDR from Switches into system, multiple rates for different services. It process CDR and generates monthly bill for customers.

Technology used: Spring MVC, Hibernate, Microsoft SQL Server, Apache POI, Jasper Report, Bootstrap
